messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quarter Orbit: OKR sync, owners & sign-off process

Hi team,

Kicking off the quarter-orbit OKR process for Q1 '27 — goal is to agree owners, success metrics, and have an executable playbook we can move into the QBR deck. Attached is my initial draft (Q1-27_OKR-draft.xlsx). High-level ask below: 

- Please review the draft and add or confirm an owner for each objective by EOD Thu, Dec 3 (PST).
- Call out any metrics you cannot commit to (we'll mark those as risers).
- Marcus: can you validate the Launch objective resource assumptions?
- Grace: please double-check the reliability targets and SLO phrasing.

I've also created a Notion workspace for comments: https://www.notion.so/redwood/Quarter-Orbit-OKR-Workspace-abc123 and linked the HS record (HS-4321) for the sales/commit context.

If we can get owners pledged by Thu EOD I will consolidate and circulate the final OKR file and the QBR deck draft on Friday. If we need a short call, propose Thu 09:00-09:30 PT (I can lock calendar).

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Platform & Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarter Orbit: OKR sync, owners & sign-off process

Thanks Rishi — reviewed the draft and made a few editorial suggestions (attached: okr-edits-2026-12-01.md). Two quick notes:

1) Under Growth > Activation metric, can we change "DAU" to "7-day active users" and pin the target to a percentage increase rather than absolute count? Easier to agree on.
2) For Security > Auditability, I'm flagging a potential cross-team dependency on the infra team's log retention change. If that can't be resolved by Jan, we should add a contingency.

I'm okay with the owner assignments you suggested, except propose swapping the owner for "Marketplace latency" to Marcus so he can align it with the launch plan. Marcus — can you confirm capacity?

If no objections, I'll mark the doc as 'ready for sign-off' once owners confirm.

-Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 01 Dec 2026 at 11:05 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rishi — reviewed the draft and made a few editorial suggestions (attached: okr-edits-2026-12-01.md).
> Marcus — can you confirm capacity?

Thanks — I reviewed and attached a short playbook (launch-playbook-v2.pdf) with resource assumptions and milestone timing. Quick callouts: 

- I can take owner for Marketplace latency, but we'll need to reallocate one backend engineer from the experimental infra backlog to the launch lane for weeks 3-7. That will cost ~0.2 FTE against innovation.
- The growth activation change from DAU to 7-day active looks fine; we'll want a short note in the QBR slide about the metric change to avoid confusion.
- For the auditability SLO, infra's log retention change is on the roadmap for mid-Jan; if that slips we should mark the metric as conditional.

I'll confirm the schedule with my PMs today and drop a final owner confirmation in the thread.

-Marcus

Attachment: launch-playbook-v2.pdf (stated as attachment in thread)

Also, looping Sarah Miller from Acme (external) to confirm the SLA expectations we'll present during their customer QBR next week. Sarah — quick read and let us know if the reliability phrasing aligns with your post-launch expectations.

Subject: Final OKR set — owners confirmed and next steps (QBR deck)

Folks — thanks for the quick turn. Owners confirmed:

- Marketplace latency — Marcus Lin (confirmed)
- Growth Activation (7-day active) — Lauren Bishop (confirmed)
- Reliability / SLOs — Grace O'Connor (confirmed; slight phrasing tweak applied)
- Launch execution / playbook — Marcus Lin (see attached)

I've consolidated changes into Q1-27_OKR-final.xlsx and started the QBR deck (QBR-deck-v1.pptx) in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qBrQBRDeckFolder.

Action items: 
- Marcus: add the resource slide to the QBR deck by EOD Mon so we can review on Tuesday's pre-QBR sync.
- Lauren: add the metric-change note for Growth Activation to slide 4.
- Grace: prepare the reliability talking points and the contingency line-item for the infra dependency.

Sarah — appreciate a quick confirmation that the reliability phrasing works for Acme's expectations ahead of next week's customer QBR.

If no objections by Mon 12/06 10:00 PT I will mark this thread as signed off and publish the consolidated packet to exec-read. Thanks all.

-Rishi
